title: Black sites staffed by refugees who didn't make the P3 cut
summary: Michael Herrera tells of Black sites staffed by refugees who didn't make the P3 cut, about present at black sites, and relays what a named person told them. As told, not a fact.

tellings.quote: They got their own people to manage these things like these refugees they get from these other countries that they scream for P3 that don't cut make the cut. Well, they have them as janitors, cooks, you know, people to maintain these facilities.

plain: A man named Michael Herrera, speaking on Jesse Michels's podcast, passed on what he says someone told him about black sites, meaning secret government facilities. According to Herrera, these places are run by their own people, including refugees from other countries who applied under a refugee category he calls P3 and didn't make the cut, and who now work there as janitors, cooks and maintenance staff. If true, the secret sites would have a hidden workforce of their own, outside public view.
